allowed.rationale: First-party read-only Brazilian public budget & fiscal MCP server with Zod runtime input validation, host-allowlisted upstream connectors, and PostgREST filter sanitization

entries.name: siconfi_entes
entries.description: Search Brazilian federal, state, and municipal entities registered in SICONFI with mandatory filter constraints.
entries.rationale: Read-only STN ORDS query validated by SiconfiEntesSchema.strict() requiring >=1 filter and capped at <=50 normalized results.

entries.name: siconfi_extrato_entregas
entries.description: Query SICONFI statement submission history (extrato de entregas) by IBGE entity code and reference year.
entries.rationale: Read-only STN ORDS query validated by SiconfiExtratoEntregasSchema.strict() with positive integer id_ente, bounded year (2015..2030), and limit <= 100.

entries.name: siconfi_rreo
entries.description: Query SICONFI Summary Budget Execution Report (RREO) accounts with annex discovery and paginated filtering.
entries.rationale: Read-only STN ORDS query validated by SiconfiRreoSchema.strict() with bimester bounds (1..6) and pagination (limit <= 50).

entries.name: siconfi_rgf
entries.description: Query SICONFI Fiscal Management Report (RGF) accounts by periodicity, branch/power, and annex with pagination.
entries.rationale: Read-only STN ORDS query validated by SiconfiRgfSchema.strict() with enum constraints on periodicity/branch and pagination (limit <= 50).

entries.name: siconfi_dca
entries.description: Query SICONFI Annual Accounts Declaration (DCA) accounting lines with annex discovery and paginated filtering.
entries.rationale: Read-only STN ORDS query validated by SiconfiDcaSchema.strict() with bounded year and pagination (limit <= 50).

entries.name: transferegov_emendas_especiais
entries.description: Query Transferegov Special Transfers (emendas Pix / art. 166-A) across action plans, executors, commitments, payments, and management reports.
entries.rationale: Read-only MGI PostgREST query validated by TransferegovEmendasEspeciaisSchema.strict() with PostgREST operator stripping, bounded limit <= 50, and LGPD homonym notice.

entries.name: transferegov_fundo_a_fundo_ted
entries.description: Query Transferegov Fundo a Fundo and TED (Termo de Execucao Descentralizada) resources.
entries.rationale: Read-only MGI PostgREST query validated by TransferegovFundoFundoTedSchema.strict() enforcing modalidade/recurso pairs, PostgREST operator stripping, and bounded limit <= 50.

entries.name: tesouro_operacoes_credito_ckan
entries.description: Query subnational credit operations (SADIPEM/PVL by UF) and search Tesouro Transparente CKAN open datasets.
entries.rationale: Read-only STN ORDS/CKAN query validated by TesouroOperacoesCreditoCkanSchema.strict() requiring 2-letter UF for PVL and bounded limit <= 50.
